WORLD 118/120:
Orra remains inland on the sleeping glass whale, its salt wells failing and the heartward tunnel sealed. Mara gives the ORRA scrap to the nearest of the unmarked three; its transparent edge still folds toward the wells from another palm. Staying beside the tapping rib-joint, Mara lays her salt-marked palm against it and answers the rhythm once with her free hand. The joint replies in the same pattern, one beat late. The walking mark stops its straight climb and forks a hairline branch toward the point of contact without leaving her skin. One direction can travel without her; the other is tied to the rib. The delayed reply may come from inside it or pass through from beyond.
CLOCKS: whale=1/4 (Whale wakes); wells=2/4 (Wells fail); bell=0/4 (Bell is answered)
CLOCK-CONSEQUENCE whale@4/4: The glass whale wakes irreversibly. The settlement names an earned cost and a new active consequence for Orra; waking alone cannot carry Orra to the sea.
CLOCK-CONSEQUENCE wells@4/4: The remaining wells cease to provide usable water. The loss persists and the settlement names the resulting active scarcity, obligation, or alternative supply.
CLOCK-CONSEQUENCE bell@4/4: The western bell receives a canonical answer that identifies what answered or why. Its original mystery closes even when the answer creates a new active consequence.
